briefing: Markets were flat today with NASDAQ +0.1% and S&P 500 +0.0%, showing no clear directional conviction. None of the top-scoring candidates showed the volume-surge confirmation needed alongside RSI/MACD signals for a high-conviction buy, so we held our 3 open slots and $789.29 cash rather than forcing a trade on a neutral day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Strong technical signals like RSI and MACD crossovers are more reliable when confirmed by a volume surge, which shows real institutional buying rather than a random price blip. Without that extra confirmation, it's often safer to wait than to chase a signal.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 像RSI和MACD黃金交叉這類技術訊號，若能配合成交量明顯放大作確認，可信度會更高，因為這代表有真實的機構買盤，而非隨機的價格波動。若缺乏這項確認，耐心等待通常比貿然追入更安全。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially sideways today, with NASDAQ up just 0.1% and the S&P 500 flat, reflecting a lack of fresh catalysts to push markets in either direction. Investors appear to be in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major news. Momentum names on our screener remain technically bullish but lack the volume confirmation that typically precedes larger moves.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅震盪，納斯達克僅升0.1%，標普500指數則報平盤，反映市場缺乏明確方向的催化劑。投資者普遍採取觀望態度，未見大幅加碼或減碼行動。雖然篩選名單中的動能股技術面仍偏多，但普遍缺乏成交量放大的確認訊號，難以構成高信心買入的理據。
